Repointing, step by step.

The mortar between the bricks keeps water out. Over time, weathering and decay open holes and gaps in it, which lets in water and can lead to damp problems. Repointing is the most effective way of making the walls weatherproof again, and it repairs the structural integrity of the brickwork.

Why repoint?

  • Stops damp getting in through holes and gaps
  • Improves how the property looks
  • Adds value, because well-kept brickwork gives a good first impression
  • Helps saleability: poor mortar is commonly raised on a valuer’s report
